source_commits.scope: Decision 0146: the live service closes an ended run's stored chains (its effect record and action history chains) when the client releases it; while a chain cannot be closed the release is refused with host.runtime.failed and the ended run stays held, so a later release or the host's end retries (F2); a run resumed after a restart whose session cannot spawn or whose job cannot begin keeps its chains open, its effect record incomplete, and a later host can still attach them (F1, tested for both failures); a new run whose session cannot spawn closes its effect record empty (N6, tested); Decision 0143's Limits clause on later hosts is corrected (N2); LOCAL-TESTING says what a refused release prints

Decision 0146 D1: the Sprint 11 storage migration compatibility producer replaces the checkout root with <repository-root> in the Cargo output it retains and refuses retained output that names the checkout or a home directory, with a test
